purpose: Durable per-source ledger of completed, rejected, inaccessible and unresolved provenance sources. Resume from here. A URL is marked checked only when it was opened in a session. A source is never marked verified as a whole; each field gets its own decision.

statusVocabulary.CHECKED_CONFIRMED: Opened. Supports the listed field values for the exact model.
statusVocabulary.CHECKED_PARTIAL: Opened. Supports some fields or models only. Remaining items stay open.
statusVocabulary.CHECKED_REJECTED: Opened. Does not support the held values. Values cleared to null.
statusVocabulary.CONFLICT: Opened, but sources or readings disagree. Values stay unchanged and the conflict is recorded.
statusVocabulary.INACCESSIBLE: Could not be opened from the sandbox. Nothing is inferred from it.
statusVocabulary.OPEN: Not yet opened or not yet complete.
